read.thesis: Q4 adjusted EPS up 6.7% to $2.23 on Suvinil and price, but volume is down low-single digits in PSG and CBG and FY26 adjusted EPS guide of $11.50–$11.90 implies only ~2.4% growth at midpoint. No supply-side discipline signal.

triggers.label: PSG price up mid-single digit in Q4
triggers.quote: selling price increases, which impacted Net sales by a mid-single digit percentage

triggers.label: Softer-for-longer into 2H26
triggers.quote: We expect these conditions to persist well into the second half of the year

guidance.quote: Full year 2026 adjusted diluted net income per share guidance in the range of $11.50 to $11.90 per share
we expect consolidated Net sales to be up by a low to mid-single digit percentage compared to 2025
we expect consolidated Net sales will be up a mid-single digit percentage compared to the first quarter of 2025

red_flags.quote: trademark impairment and other costs associated with targeted restructuring actions
